title: EXP-079 - Hello World Part 5 Section 2b: Join FX_Items to the FX_Orders IDO and Add FX_ItmsDescription, FX_ItmsCost and FX_ItmsPicture
objective: Follow hello-world-pt5.md Sections 1-2 (00:28-03:33) for the items table, adapted to FX_ names and the EXP-078 route. In the Web Client IDO Collections runtime Form (titled IDOs), retrieve exactly the IDO FX_Orders (project FX_HelloWorldProject01; checked out to the operator since EXP-078; tables FX_Orders fxords and FX_HelloWorld01 fxcus; 13 properties) and record its identity, revision, checkout state, Tables view and complete property inventory. Add the secondary table FX_Items once with alias fxitms and the join fxitms.FX_Item = fxords.FX_Item (the tutorial's "Items.Item = Orders.Item"). Then run the New Property wizard three times, Bound: FX_ItmsDescription bound to fxitms.FX_Description with no property class, FX_ItmsCost bound to fxitms.FX_Cost with property class FX_Cost, and FX_ItmsPicture bound to fxitms.FX_Picture with property class FX_Picture. Close and reopen IDO Collections once, verify the Tables view and the inventory equal the baseline plus the join and the three properties, and confirm the two FX_Orders runtime records still load. No Check Out is needed; FX_Orders stays checked out. Findings are observed only.

in_scope: Read AGENTS.md, docs/mongoose/transcripts/hello-world-pt5.md Sections 1-2 (00:28-03:33), the EXP-078 record (FX_Orders join route: Table Name typed and Tab-committed, alias, Secondary / Left Outer, join builder and bracketed join text; New Property wizard on a joined column; joined properties Read Only; duplicate sequence numbers; Filter in Place on reopen), the EXP-061 record (New Property wizard with a property class: Property Class lookup, inherited types, Inherit from Property Class checkboxes), the EXP-066-R2 record (auto-filled Property Name replaced by one plain fill), the EXP-048 and EXP-060 records (property classes FX_Cost: Decimal 18/2, decimal; FX_Picture: Binary -1, varbinary) and the EXP-073 record (the two FX_Orders runtime rows; blank-criteria query) before browser interaction.
Create or update only experiments/EXP-079-hello-world-part-5-section-2b-fx-orders-items-join.md and evidence/EXP-079/ documentation and evidence files.
Record the worker-written-file inventory and a cumulative browser action audit with exact counts.

Use the existing authenticated session without refresh, restart or configuration change. If it expires, follow the worker-preamble session-expiry procedure once and end the task. List the browser tabs before the first tab selection. Do not touch the Web Designer tab.

Fresh IDOs Form: if the IDOs tab is open and clean, close it once through its Form-tab control and reopen it once through Form > Open > Select Form. Check the status bar for Filter in Place before clicking it.

Target and baseline: in Filter in Place, type FX_Orders into the IDO Name criterion, commit with Tab, capture the criterion before F4, press F4 once and establish exactly one FX_Orders row. Record project, Revision, Locked By and the checkout state (expected checked out to the operator, Revision 2); the Tables view (expected two entries: FX_HelloWorld01 fxcus Secondary Left Outer with the fxcus join, and FX_Orders fxords Primary Base Inner); and the complete property inventory (expected 13: FX_OrderNumber, FX_CusName, FX_CustomerID, FX_Item, FX_Count, FX_CusAddress and the 7 system properties). Prove FX_ItmsDescription, FX_ItmsCost, FX_ItmsPicture and any fxitms entry absent.
Checkout gate: proceed only if FX_Orders is checked out to the operator. This experiment contains no checkout-management action at all; if it is checked in, locked by another user or ambiguous, stop.

Join: in the Tables view click New Table once. Type FX_Items into the Table Name combobox once and press Tab once (never Enter, never a list pick); verify the readback FX_Items with no message. Type fxitms into Table Alias and press Tab once. Keep Table Type Secondary and Join Type Left Outer. In the join builder choose FX_Item as the first Column Name, fxords as the Table Name and FX_Item as the second Column Name, click the builder Add once and record the join text verbatim; it must express fxitms.FX_Item = fxords.FX_Item. If the builder lacks these values, type fxitms.[FX_Item] = fxords.[FX_Item] into the join-text area once instead. Record every field, click the wizard OK once and record the response. Verify the Tables view lists exactly FX_HelloWorld01 (fxcus), FX_Items (fxitms) and FX_Orders (fxords) with both joins.

Property FX_ItmsDescription: open the New Property wizard once, keep Bound, select fxitms.FX_Description from the Bind To lookup (the alias prefix distinguishes it), Property Name FX_ItmsDescription by one plain fill replacing any auto-filled name, leave Property Class blank and record the shown Data Type, Length and SQL type (expected String, 150, nvarchar); Finish once and record the response.

Property FX_ItmsCost: open the New Property wizard once more, keep Bound, select fxitms.FX_Cost, Property Name FX_ItmsCost by one plain fill, select FX_Cost once from the Property Class lookup and record the readback, the inherit checkboxes and the shown types (expected Decimal, Length 18, Decimal Position 2, decimal); Finish once and record the response.

Property FX_ItmsPicture: open the New Property wizard once more, keep Bound, select fxitms.FX_Picture, Property Name FX_ItmsPicture by one plain fill, select FX_Picture once from the Property Class lookup and record the readback, the inherit checkboxes and the shown types (expected Binary, -1, varbinary); Finish once and record the response.

After the Finishes, perform at most one ordinary Save only if the Form was left dirty. Verify exactly three added properties (Bound to the fxitms columns, with the recorded classes, types, sequence numbers and Read Only state) and the original 13 unchanged; verify FX_Orders is checked out to the operator.

Close the clean IDOs Form once more and reopen it once more (the recovery pair); run one fresh visible-criterion FX_Orders query and compare the recovered Tables view, property inventory and checkout state with the baseline plus the join and the three properties.

Runtime check: in the FX_Orders runtime Form (close it once if open and clean, reopen it once through Form > Open > Select Form) run one blank-criteria query (Filter in Place, blank criteria, one F4) and verify exactly the two rows 1 / FX001 / dumbbell / 2 and 2 / FX002 / eggs / 1 with Save disabled; change nothing.

Capture screenshots of the pre-F4 criteria, the baseline Tables view and inventory, the New Table dialog before OK, the Tables view after OK, each wizard before Finish, the post-change inventory, the recovered Tables view and inventory, and the runtime rows.
Record any blocker after at most one fresh untargeted snapshot and one corrected visible inspection. Classify findings as observed only.
